$comment: Performance budgets (#108), checked by `npm run budgets` in CI's budgets job. Raise a number only in a pull request that says why. Kernel and viewport baselines are a CI runner's own medians (2 to 3 times a laptop's); the check fails when a median is over its baseline by more than the tolerance.

bundle.$comment: KB gzipped, per chunk. The shell is the JavaScript index.html loads before first paint. totalJs went from 600 to 620 in #312: main was already at 601.9 after the text tool (#309) added fonts (glyphs, 50 KB, loaded only when you place text), alongside the path tracer (63 KB, loaded only for Render); the shell cap is what guards first paint. The shell went from 355 to 358 in #310: main was at 354.6, and dragging an arm by its tool point (#176) adds 1.2 KB of glue (the tool marker, the palette commands, the lock toggle) after its solver and drag moved to a lazy chunk. 358 to 361 in the clash check (#178): main was at 357.9, and the check adds 0.8 KB (its state, the overlap boxes, the command); its list and the kernel work load later. What's new (#319) adds 0.4 KB (the Help entry, the command and the hook); the notes, the seen list, the card and the dialog load later. totalJs went from 620 to 630 with named poses (#177): main was at 618.1 and they add 1.9 KB; everything past first paint loads on use. totalJs went from 630 to 632 with components (#171): main was at about 629.3 after the shell trim (#332) split code into lazy chunks, and components add 1.0 KB (the nested browser, the active component, two icons). The shell went from 361 to 362 for dropping a sketch point on another point or a line to join it (#326): main was at 360.7, and the drag glue adds 0.4 KB (the snap while dragging, the coincident on drop); finding what it drops on loads with the sketch. The clash sweep (#179) adds 0.1 KB (its command and the panel props); the sweep, its state and the mesh test load later. #320 took the shell to under 355 and the cap back to 355: the move gizmo (TransformControls), the catalogue's parts list, file import and the problem report's zip code now load after first paint.

wasm.$comment: MB. OCCT is the opencascade.js build replicad ships (23 MB); the issue's 12 MB / 3.5 MB target needs a slimmer build of the same unmodified OCCT (#4, #50).

viewport.$comment: Since #204 the view fills the 1280 x 800 window (3.3 times the pixels it had), and the frame is 34 to 84 ms on runners depending on the runner (the kernel numbers swing by the same factor in the same runs). Baseline 90 leaves the same headroom over a fast runner as the kernel budgets have.

lighthouse.$comment: Desktop preset, Chromium with SwiftShader as CI runs it. Software WebGL compiles the view's shaders on the main thread (about 1 s of blocking time); with WebGL off the score is 100. The target is 0.85.
